actions.description: Measure optical or radiant intensity at a declared wavelength or channel and return the value with its unit and integration time.

inputs.description: Wavelength in nanometres; the driver reads the detector pixel whose calibrated wavelength is nearest to it. Leave it out to read the brightest pixel
inputs.name: wavelength_nm

inputs.description: Integration time to apply before the measurement, in milliseconds; leave it out to measure with the integration time the device already has
inputs.name: integration_ms

actions.name: measure_intensity

actions.description: Set the detector integration time (Spectrometer.integration_time_micros); the value is given in whole microseconds after the conversion from milliseconds

inputs.description: Integration time to set, in milliseconds
inputs.name: integration_ms

actions.name: set_integration_time

outputs.description: The integration time the driver applied, in milliseconds (whole microseconds)
outputs.name: integration_ms

facts.text: Spectrometer is the model independent interface to all spectrometers the backends support
from_first_available opens the first available unopened spectrometer
from_serial_number opens the spectrometer with the given serial number and refuses one that is already open
wavelengths() returns the wavelength in (nm) that corresponds to each pixel of the spectrometer
intensities() returns the measured intensities in arbitrary units (a.u.), and the measuring behavior can be adjusted by setting the trigger mode
The intensities are in arbitrary units and their range depends on the ADC bit resolution of the hardware of the specific spectrometer
max_intensity is the maximum intensity the spectrometer can return in (a.u.); the spectrometer may saturate at lower values
integration_time_micros() sets the detector integration time, in microseconds
integration_time_micros_limits returns the min and max integration time in microseconds that the device reports
The trigger mode value is the one the device's datasheet defines; the class states no enumeration for a generic device
serial_number is the spectrometer's serial number and model is its model type
pixels is the number of pixels of the spectrometer's detector
features returns a dictionary of all supported features of the spectrometer and gives direct access to the features provided by the backend interface
close() closes the connection to the SeaBreezeDevice
The pyseabreeze backend declares the integration time bounds per spectrometer model: USB2000PLUS 1000 and 655350000 microseconds
The pyseabreeze backend declares different integration time bounds for the USB2000: 3000 and 655350000 microseconds
The GPIO feature class of the pyseabreeze backend is a definition only: the module is marked TODO and every method raises NotImplementedError
The pixel-binning feature class of the pyseabreeze backend is a definition only: the module is marked TODO and every method raises NotImplementedError
The README acquires a spectrum by setting the integration time and then calling wavelengths() and intensities()
